meta.name: smart-explore
meta.description: Token-optimized structural code search using tree-sitter AST parsing. Use instead of reading full files when you need to understand code structure, find functions, or explore a codebase efficiently.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用AST解析快速搜索代码结构，替代逐文件阅读
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要在不熟悉的代码库中快速找到函数或结构
copy.tagline_en: Search code structure quickly with AST parsing, replacing full file reads
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to quickly find functions or structures in unfamiliar codebases

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 不再把整个代码文件从头读到尾,而是先搜索定位相关文件,再看单个文件的结构骨架,最后只展开你关心的函数或类的完整代码。
howto.when: 当你需要理解代码结构、查找某个函数,或想高效探索代码库时触发,它会接替默认的逐文件阅读方式。

say.text: 别读整个文件,先找 src 里和 shutdown 有关的函数。
say.note: 会先做代码搜索并返回结果,而不是读完整文件。

say.text: 把 worker-service.ts 的结构列出来,别读全文。
say.note: 会返回函数、类等结构骨架,方便定位。

say.text: 只展开 worker-service.ts 里 shutdown 函数的源码。
say.note: 会返回该函数完整实现,不读整个文件。

howto.what_en: With this skill, Claude stops reading whole code files end-to-end. It first searches to locate relevant files, then gets a one-file structural outline, and only unfolds the complete code of the function or class you care about.
howto.when_en: It activates when you need to understand code structure, find a function, or explore a codebase efficiently, taking over the default file-by-file reading.

say_en.text: Don't read the whole file. First find functions related to shutdown in src.
say_en.note: Searches symbols first; no full file read.

say_en.text: Show the structure of worker-service.ts without reading the whole file.
Expand only the shutdown function in worker-service.ts.
say_en.note: Returns full source for that single function only.
